headline: Chilean IPSA index crosses 10,500 points as copper rebounds
summary: Chile's IPSA index surpassed 10,500 points amid improved global sentiment and a rebound in copper prices, though trading volumes remained low during the US holiday.
why: Stock market performance in Chile is closely linked to copper export earnings and global macroeconomic sentiment.

impacts.name: IPSA Index
impacts.why: The index tracks the principal equities listed on the Santiago Stock Exchange.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A recovery in copper prices and improved global sentiment drove buyers into local equities.
